title: Resizable inspector
description: Resize an editing surface while its adjacent controls remain useful.
useCase: Resize an editing surface while its adjacent controls remain useful.
reducedMotion: Live system preference disables decorative motion; all controls remain usable. Keyboard actions settle immediately.
limitations: Canvas width is interactive; neighboring inspector values are static.
look: Cool blue-grey page with a rounded editor window: dotted canvas with a tilted slate-blue shape, pill drag handle and a compact property inspector.
motion: Dragging the divider resizes the canvas 1:1 with the pointer, clamped to 38–72% of the width (arrow keys step 2%); the inspector flexes and the size readout updates.
adapt: Resizing is the `update` function converting `clientX` into `split` (clamped 38–72) on the `.divider` separator, with pointer capture and arrow, Home and End keys. Replace the `.artboard` object and the `.inspector` fields with your panes.
